mapper.select: SELECT c.COMPANY_IDX AS company_idx, u.USER_IDX AS users_idx, u.USER_NAME AS user_name, u.STATUS AS status, c.COMPANY_NUM AS company_num, NVL(ce.CERT_STATUS, '미등록') AS cert_status FROM USERS u JOIN COMPANY c ON u.USER_IDX = c.USER_IDX LEFT JOIN CERT ce ON ce.USER_IDX = u.USER_IDX AND ce.CERT_TYPE = '사업증' WHERE u.USER_TYPE = 'COMPANY' ORDER BY CASE WHEN NVL(ce.CERT_STATUS,'미등록') = '대기' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.USER_IDX DESC
